The '''301st Infantry''' was a unit in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Army|Army's]] [[Republic Infantry|Infantry Division]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], the 301st was deployed to the ice [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they battled the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and later the Imperial military when the Sith arrived in force. A detachment under [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was assigned to the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Leeha Narezz]] on their mission to recover schematics of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space fortress]].
